description:
Guys Reach out to me on my email, please

Hey, I’m Mohammad, an Engineering I student at McMaster from India, previously at BITS Pilani, Goa. I’m interested in space exploration and engineering, and I’m putting together a team to identify Earth locations that could serve as analogues for permanent Moon and Mars bases. We’ll research potential sites, study their environments, and explore the challenges of building future extraterrestrial settlements!
